purpose: Canonical coverage index for stored Chinese and English teacher-facing comparison copy.
resolution_rule: Resolve the same concept_id in the requested language. Never translate curriculum jurisdiction labels into false grade equivalents.
guardrails: Stored copy is explanatory interpretation layered on source-backed curriculum records; it does not replace evidence records.
China exact current PEP grade/semester claims remain pending unless direct current-volume evidence exists.
England means the National Curriculum in England and separately labelled DfE/NCETM guidance.
US means Common Core baseline unless a specific state framework is selected.
Earlier or later placement is descriptive, not a quality judgement.
Do not infer national teaching frequency from curriculum or guidance.
Copy remains direct, educational and non-promotional.
